seo.title: Stand | Experiences and data for trade shows and activations
seo.description: Improve every visitor's experience and collect participation data at trade shows and activations with customizable branded games. Review results and analytics based on your plan.

hero.subtitle: Stand helps brands and agencies improve the experience at trade shows and activations with customizable games that invite people to take part and collect participation data and results to show how audiences respond.
hero.microcopy: Plug & play: launch your game with a link, a QR code, or a screen.
hero.visualAlt: Horizontal and vertical touchscreens for in-person activations
hero.visualCaption: Use your own screen or rent one from us as an add-on service.

about.intro: Stand helps brands and agencies improve every visit with participatory experiences and collect game and results data to understand audience response.

pillars.title: Improve every visitor's experience
pillars.description: Offer a customizable branded activity that invites people to take part and adds an enjoyable moment to your trade show or activation.

pillars.title: Collect participation data
pillars.description: Review game data and results. Depending on your plan, you can export them or add post-event analytics.

about.problemTitle: Create an experience and understand the response
about.problemBody: At a trade show, catching people's attention is only part of the challenge: you also want to offer an experience that invites participation and understand how audiences respond. Stand combines branded activities with participation data and results.

howItWorks.title: A better experience, data to learn from
howItWorks.subtitle: Create a branded activity, launch the experience your way, and review the data generated by the game.

steps.title: Choose an activity
steps.description: Pick a game from the catalog based on the experience you want to offer and the participation you want to understand.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.description: Customize the visuals and, depending on your plan, adapt the content and mechanics to your activation.

steps.title: Launch and review results
steps.description: Invite people to play, then review or export the results available with your plan.

activation.title: Launch your game your way
activation.description: From a link to a screen at your event: choose the option that fits your space.

options.title: Share a link
options.description: Send the game link so participants can access it on their own devices.

options.title: Print a QR code
options.description: Place the QR code in your space so visitors can scan it and access the game.

options.title: Use your screen
options.description: Show the game's home screen on your own display during the event.

options.title: Rent a screen
options.description: You can also rent a screen from us as an add-on service.

clientLogos.title: Stand in action
clientLogos.intro: An example of how a game can bring a space to life.

zoco.description: For a pilot at a nightclub, we brought Stand to the venue with two games designed to encourage participation in a nightlife setting.
zoco.context: A nightlife pilot at Zoco Dance Club; not a trade show or brand-activation case study.

catalog.subtitle: Games with different mechanics for trade shows and activations. Customize the visual experience to fit your brand.

games.title: L3TRAS
games.description: Arrange your letters to spell the target word before the others. The leaderboard is optional.

games.title: RULET4
games.description: Customize a prize or challenge wheel to offer giveaways and activities to visitors.

games.title: T1MER
games.description: Tap at the exact moment shown by the timer. Play solo or in a room with a leaderboard.

games.title: EMPAREJA2
games.description: Find your assigned match in the room and exchange codes. A way to spark new conversations.

games.title: CUPIDO
games.description: Answer a questionnaire, see compatibility on a traffic light, then find your match and validate the code.

games.title: SEMAFORO
games.description: Answer a cross-quiz and reveal the result with a colored traffic light: a reason to start a conversation.

games.title: INFOCARDS
games.description: Present information as visual cards. Upload a PDF or images to generate the cards with AI.

games.title: STACK
games.description: Stack blocks in a 3D arcade game. Tap at the right moment, chain perfect placements, and build the tallest tower.

pricing.subtitle: From a free first try to an experience with tailored services.
pricing.footerNote: Prices are in euros. Optional Enterprise services are quoted separately.

starter.name: Starter
starter.description: Get to know the platform before planning an activation.

event.name: Event
event.description: Access for a trade show, event, or one-off activation.

event.priceNoteWeek: One-time payment for 7 days of access

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: For activations that need additional services or adaptations.
enterprise.priceModularNote: The final price depends on the optional services included in the proposal.
services: Logistics and transport to the venue

contact.intro: Tell us which brand or agency you represent, what event you are planning, and what kind of experience you want to offer.
contact.placeholderMessage: Tell us about the trade show or activation, the experience you have in mind, and any details that help explain it.
